prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml; find src -name '*.py' | xargs wc -l; mypy 2>&1 | tail -40
cat src/trailhead/elevation.py src/trailhead/pace.py src/trailhead/report.py src/trailhead/track.py; ls tests; git log --oneline | head
cat README.md; grep -rn -i "none\|missing\|ele\b\|,$" tests | head -40; cat src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/cli.py; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15

cd src && python -c '
from trailhead.track import parse_track, TrackError
from trailhead.report import summarise, format_summary
from trailhead.plan import split_days
t = parse_track("lat,lon,ele
0,0,
0,0.01,100
0,0.02,
0,0.03,200
0,0.04,
")
print(t.elevations()); print(format_summary(summarise(t))); print(split_days(t))
try: parse_track("lat,lon,ele
0,0,
0,0.01,
").elevations()
except TrackError as e: print("TrackError:", e)
'
printf 'lat,lon,ele
0,0,
0,0.01,
' > /tmp/claude/x.csv; python -m trailhead summary /tmp/claude/x.csv; echo "exit $?"
